I'll create a comprehensive Python library for interacting with the MythTV server API. This library will handle the most common operations and provide a clean interface for developers.

```python
"""
MythTV API Client Library
A Python library for interacting with MythTV backend servers
"""

import requests
import json
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Union
from urllib.parse import urljoin, quote
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from enum import Enum

# Configure logging
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MythTVError(Exception):
    """Base exception for MythTV API errors"""
    pass


class MythTVConnectionError(MythTVError):
    """Raised when connection to MythTV backend fails"""
    pass


class MythTVAPIError(MythTVError):
    """Raised when API returns an error"""
    pass


class RecordingStatus(Enum):
    """Recording status enumeration"""
    UNKNOWN = -13
    MISSED = -11
    RECORDING = -2
    WILL_RECORD = -1
    DONT_RECORD = 0
    PREVIOUS_RECORDING = 1
    CURRENT_RECORDING = 2
    EARLIER_SHOWING = 3
    TOO_MANY_RECORDINGS = 4
    NOT_LISTED = 5
    CONFLICT = 6
    LATER_SHOWING = 7
    REPEAT = 8
    INACTIVE = 9
    NEVER_RECORD = 10


@dataclass
class Channel:
    """Represents a TV channel"""
    chan_id: int
    chan_num: str
    callsign: str
    name: str
    icon: Optional[str] = None
    visible: bool = True
    xmltv_id: Optional[str] = None
    default_auth: Optional[str] = None
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict) -> 'Channel':
        return cls(
            chan_id=data.get('ChanId'),
            chan_num=data.get('ChanNum'),
            callsign=data.get('CallSign'),
            name=data.get('ChannelName'),
            icon=data.get('IconURL'),
            visible=data.get('Visible', True),
            xmltv_id=data.get('XMLTVID'),
            default_auth=data.get('DefaultAuth')
        )


@dataclass
class Program:
    """Represents a TV program"""
    start_time: datetime
    end_time: datetime
    title: str
    subtitle: Optional[str] = None
    description: Optional[str] = None
    category: Optional[str] = None
    chan_id: Optional[int] = None
    callsign: Optional[str] = None
    file_size: Optional[int] = None
    host_name: Optional[str] = None
    recording_id: Optional[int] = None
    recording_status: Optional[RecordingStatus] = None
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict) -> 'Program':
        # Parse datetime strings
        start_time = datetime.fromisoformat(data['StartTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        end_time = datetime.fromisoformat(data['EndTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        
        # Get recording status if available
        rec_status = None
        if 'Recording' in data and 'Status' in data['Recording']:
            try:
                rec_status = RecordingStatus(data['Recording']['Status'])
            except ValueError:
                rec_status = RecordingStatus.UNKNOWN
        
        return cls(
            start_time=start_time,
            end_time=end_time,
            title=data.get('Title', ''),
            subtitle=data.get('SubTitle'),
            description=data.get('Description'),
            category=data.get('Category'),
            chan_id=data.get('Channel', {}).get('ChanId'),
            callsign=data.get('Channel', {}).get('CallSign'),
            file_size=data.get('FileSize'),
            host_name=data.get('HostName'),
            recording_id=data.get('Recording', {}).get('RecordedId'),
            recording_status=rec_status
        )


@dataclass
class Recording:
    """Represents a recorded program"""
    recorded_id: int
    title: str
    subtitle: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]
    start_time: datetime
    end_time: datetime
    file_size: int
    file_name: str
    host_name: str
    channel_name: Optional[str]
    recording_group: str
    storage_group: str
    play_group: str
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict) -> 'Recording':
        start_time = datetime.fromisoformat(data['StartTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        end_time = datetime.fromisoformat(data['EndTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        
        return cls(
            recorded_id=data['RecordedId'],
            title=data['Title'],
            subtitle=data.get('SubTitle'),
            description=data.get('Description'),
            start_time=start_time,
            end_time=end_time,
            file_size=data.get('FileSize', 0),
            file_name=data.get('FileName', ''),
            host_name=data.get('HostName', ''),
            channel_name=data.get('Channel', {}).get('ChannelName'),
            recording_group=data.get('RecGroup', 'Default'),
            storage_group=data.get('StorageGroup', 'Default'),
            play_group=data.get('PlayGroup', 'Default')
        )


@dataclass
class RecordingRule:
    """Represents a recording rule/schedule"""
    record_id: int
    title: str
    subtitle: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]
    category: Optional[str]
    start_time: datetime
    end_time: datetime
    chan_id: int
    callsign: str
    type: str
    search_type: str
    rec_priority: int
    inactive: bool
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict) -> 'RecordingRule':
        start_time = datetime.fromisoformat(data['StartTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        end_time = datetime.fromisoformat(data['EndTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        
        return cls(
            record_id=data['Id'],
            title=data['Title'],
            subtitle=data.get('SubTitle'),
            description=data.get('Description'),
            category=data.get('Category'),
            start_time=start_time,
            end_time=end_time,
            chan_id=data['ChanId'],
            callsign=data.get('CallSign', ''),
            type=data.get('Type', 'Single'),
            search_type=data.get('SearchType', 'None'),
            rec_priority=data.get('RecPriority', 0),
            inactive=data.get('Inactive', False)
        )


class MythTVAPI:
    """Main MythTV API client class"""
    
    def __init__(self, host: str, port: int = 6544, username: Optional[str] = None, 
                 password: Optional[str] = None, timeout: int = 30):
        """
        Initialize MythTV API client
        
        Args:
            host: MythTV backend hostname or IP
            port: API port (default 6544)
            username: Optional username for authentication
            password: Optional password for authentication
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds
        """
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.base_url = f"http://{host}:{port}"
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.session = requests.Session()
        
        if username and password:
            self.session.auth = (username, password)
        
        # Set default headers
        self.session.headers.update({
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        })
    
    def _make_request(self, method: str, endpoint: str, 
                     params: Optional[Dict] = None, 
                     data: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Dict:
        """
        Make HTTP request to MythTV API
        
        Args:
            method: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
            endpoint: API endpoint path
            params: Query parameters
            data: Request body data
            
        Returns:
            JSON response as dictionary
            
        Raises:
            MythTVConnectionError: If connection fails
            MythTVAPIError: If API returns an error
        """
        url = urljoin(self.base_url, endpoint)
        
        try:
            response = self.session.request(
                method=method,
                url=url,
                params=params,
                json=data,
                timeout=self.timeout
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            
            # Some endpoints return empty responses
            if response.text:
                return response.json()
            return {}
            
        except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError as e:
            raise MythTVConnectionError(f"Failed to connect to {self.host}:{self.port}: {e}")
        except requests.exceptions.HTTPError as e:
            raise MythTVAPIError(f"API error: {e}")
        except requests.exceptions.Timeout as e:
            raise MythTVConnectionError(f"Request timeout: {e}")
        except Exception as e:
            raise MythTVError(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
    
    # Channel Management
    
    def get_channels(self, only_visible: bool = True) -> List[Channel]:
        """
        Get list of channels
        
        Args:
            only_visible: Only return visible channels
            
        Returns:
            List of Channel objects
        """
        params = {'OnlyVisible': str(only_visible).lower()}
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Channel/GetChannelInfoList', params=params)
        
        channels = []
        for chan_data in response.get('ChannelInfoList', {}).get('ChannelInfos', []):
            channels.append(Channel.from_dict(chan_data))
        
        return channels
    
    def get_channel(self, chan_id: int) -> Optional[Channel]:
        """
        Get specific channel information
        
        Args:
            chan_id: Channel ID
            
        Returns:
            Channel object or None if not found
        """
        params = {'ChanID': chan_id}
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Channel/GetChannelInfo', params=params)
        
        if response.get('ChannelInfo'):
            return Channel.from_dict(response['ChannelInfo'])
        return None
    
    # Program Guide
    
    def get_program_guide(self, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime,
                         chan_id: Optional[int] = None,
                         num_channels: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """
        Get program guide data
        
        Args:
            start_time: Start time for guide data
            end_time: End time for guide data
            chan_id: Optional specific channel ID
            num_channels: Optional number of channels to return
            
        Returns:
            List of Program objects
        """
        params = {
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat(),
            'EndTime': end_time.isoformat()
        }
        
        if chan_id:
            params['StartChanId'] = chan_id
        if num_channels:
            params['NumOfChannels'] = num_channels
        
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramGuide', params=params)
        
        programs = []
        for chan in response.get('ProgramGuide', {}).get('Channels', []):
            for prog_data in chan.get('Programs', []):
                # Add channel info to program
                prog_data['Channel'] = {
                    'ChanId': chan.get('ChanId'),
                    'CallSign': chan.get('CallSign')
                }
                programs.append(Program.from_dict(prog_data))
        
        return programs
    
    def get_program_details(self, chan_id: int, start_time: datetime) -> Optional[Program]:
        """
        Get detailed program information
        
        Args:
            chan_id: Channel ID
            start_time: Program start time
            
        Returns:
            Program object or None if not found
        """
        params = {
            'ChanId': chan_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat()
        }
        
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramDetails', params=params)
        
        if response.get('Program'):
            return Program.from_dict(response['Program'])
        return None
    
    # Recording Management
    
    def get_recordings(self, rec_group: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Recording]:
        """
        Get list of recordings
        
        Args:
            rec_group: Optional recording group filter
            
        Returns:
            List of Recording objects
        """
        params = {}
        if rec_group:
            params['RecGroup'] = rec_group
        
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecordedList', params=params)
        
        recordings = []
        for rec_data in response.get('ProgramList', {}).get('Programs', []):
            recordings.append(Recording.from_dict(rec_data))
        
        return recordings
    
    def get_recording(self, recorded_id: int) -> Optional[Recording]:
        """
        Get specific recording information
        
        Args:
            recorded_id: Recording ID
            
        Returns:
            Recording object or None if not found
        """
        params = {'RecordedId': recorded_id}
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecorded', params=params)
        
        if response.get('Program'):
            return Recording.from_dict(response['Program'])
        return None
    
    def delete_recording(self, recorded_id: int, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording
        
        Args:
            recorded_id: Recording ID to delete
            force: Force deletion even if file is in use
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {
            'RecordedId': recorded_id,
            'ForceDelete': str(force).lower()
        }
        
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/DeleteRecording', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
    
    def stop_recording(self, recorded_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Stop an active recording
        
        Args:
            recorded_id: Recording ID to stop
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {'RecordedId': recorded_id}
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/StopRecording', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
    
    # Recording Rules/Schedules
    
    def get_recording_rules(self) -> List[RecordingRule]:
        """
        Get all recording rules
        
        Returns:
            List of RecordingRule objects
        """
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecordScheduleList')
        
        rules = []
        for rule_data in response.get('RecRuleList', {}).get('RecRules', []):
            rules.append(RecordingRule.from_dict(rule_data))
        
        return rules
    
    def get_recording_rule(self, record_id: int) -> Optional[RecordingRule]:
        """
        Get specific recording rule
        
        Args:
            record_id: Recording rule ID
            
        Returns:
            RecordingRule object or None if not found
        """
        params = {'RecordId': record_id}
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecordSchedule', params=params)
        
        if response.get('RecRule'):
            return RecordingRule.from_dict(response['RecRule'])
        return None
    
    def add_recording_rule(self, chan_id: int, start_time: datetime, 
                          rule_type: str = 'Single',
                          title: Optional[str] = None,
                          subtitle: Optional[str] = None,
                          description: Optional[str] = None,
                          category: Optional[str] = None,
                          rec_priority: int = 0) -> Optional[int]:
        """
        Add a new recording rule
        
        Args:
            chan_id: Channel ID
            start_time: Program start time
            rule_type: Type of rule (Single, Weekly, Daily, etc.)
            title: Program title
            subtitle: Program subtitle
            description: Program description
            category: Program category
            rec_priority: Recording priority
            
        Returns:
            New recording rule ID or None if failed
        """
        params = {
            'ChanId': chan_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat(),
            'Type': rule_type,
            'RecPriority': rec_priority
        }
        
        if title:
            params['Title'] = title
        if subtitle:
            params['Subtitle'] = subtitle
        if description:
            params['Description'] = description
        if category:
            params['Category'] = category
        
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/AddRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('int')
    
    def update_recording_rule(self, record_id: int, **kwargs) -> bool:
        """
        Update an existing recording rule
        
        Args:
            record_id: Recording rule ID
            **kwargs: Fields to update
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        # Get current rule
        rule = self.get_recording_rule(record_id)
        if not rule:
            raise MythTVAPIError(f"Recording rule {record_id} not found")
        
        # Update fields
        params = {
            'RecordId': record_id,
            'ChanId': kwargs.get('chan_id', rule.chan_id),
            'StartTime': kwargs.get('start_time', rule.start_time).isoformat(),
            'Type': kwargs.get('rule_type', rule.type),
            'RecPriority': kwargs.get('rec_priority', rule.rec_priority),
            'Title': kwargs.get('title', rule.title),
            'Inactive': str(kwargs.get('inactive', rule.inactive)).lower()
        }
        
        if rule.subtitle or 'subtitle' in kwargs:
            params['Subtitle'] = kwargs.get('subtitle', rule.subtitle)
        if rule.description or 'description' in kwargs:
            params['Description'] = kwargs.get('description', rule.description)
        if rule.category or 'category' in kwargs:
            params['Category'] = kwargs.get('category', rule.category)
        
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/UpdateRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
    
    def delete_recording_rule(self, record_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording rule
        
        Args:
            record_id: Recording rule ID to delete
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {'RecordId': record_id}
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/RemoveRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)

    # Program Guide
    
    def get_program_guide(self, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime,
                         chan_id: Optional[int] = None,
                         num_channels: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """
        Get program guide data
        
        Args:
            start_time: Start time for guide data
            end_time: End time for guide data
            chan_id: Optional specific channel ID
            num_channels: Optional number of channels to return
            
        Returns:
            List of Program objects
        """
        params = {
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat(),
            'EndTime': end_time.isoformat()
        }
        
        if chan_id:
            params['StartChanId'] = chan_id
        if num_channels:
            params['NumOfChannels'] = num_channels
        
        response = self._make_request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramGuide', params=params)
        
        programs = []
        for chan in response.get('ProgramGuide', {}).get('Channels', []):
            for prog_data in chan.get('Programs', []):
                # Add channel info to program
                prog_data['Channel'] = {
                    'ChanId': chan.get('ChanId'),
                    'CallSign': chan.get('CallSign')
                }
                programs.append(Program.from_dict(prog_data))
        
        return programs

    def add_recording_rule(self, chan_id: int, start_time: datetime, 
                          rule_type: str = 'Single',
                          title: Optional[str] = None,
                          subtitle: Optional[str] = None,
                          description: Optional[str] = None,
                          category: Optional[str] = None,
                          rec_priority: int = 0) -> Optional[int]:
        """
        Add a new recording rule
        
        Args:
            chan_id: Channel ID
            start_time: Program start time
            rule_type: Type of rule (Single, Weekly, Daily, etc.)
            title: Program title
            subtitle: Program subtitle
            description: Program description
            category: Program category
            rec_priority: Recording priority
            
        Returns:
            New recording rule ID or None if failed
        """
        params = {
            'ChanId': chan_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat(),
            'Type': rule_type,
            'RecPriority': rec_priority
        }
        
        if title:
            params['Title'] = title
        if subtitle:
            params['Subtitle'] = subtitle
        if description:
            params['Description'] = description
        if category:
            params['Category'] = category
        
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/AddRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('int')
    
    def update_recording_rule(self, record_id: int, **kwargs) -> bool:
        """
        Update an existing recording rule
        
        Args:
            record_id: Recording rule ID
            **kwargs: Fields to update
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        # Get current rule
        rule = self.get_recording_rule(record_id)
        if not rule:
            raise MythTVAPIError(f"Recording rule {record_id} not found")
        
        # Update fields
        params = {
            'RecordId': record_id,
            'ChanId': kwargs.get('chan_id', rule.chan_id),
            'StartTime': kwargs.get('start_time', rule.start_time).isoformat(),
            'Type': kwargs.get('rule_type', rule.type),
            'RecPriority': kwargs.get('rec_priority', rule.rec_priority),
            'Title': kwargs.get('title', rule.title),
            'Inactive': str(kwargs.get('inactive', rule.inactive)).lower()
        }
        
        if rule.subtitle or 'subtitle' in kwargs:
            params['Subtitle'] = kwargs.get('subtitle', rule.subtitle)
        if rule.description or 'description' in kwargs:
            params['Description'] = kwargs.get('description', rule.description)
        if rule.category or 'category' in kwargs:
            params['Category'] = kwargs.get('category', rule.category)
        
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/UpdateRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
    
    def delete_recording_rule(self, record_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording rule
        
        Args:
            record_id: Recording rule ID to delete
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {'RecordId': record_id}
        response = self._make_request('POST', '/Dvr/RemoveRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
